messages:
Priya: Heads up — Mel accepted onsite + remote panel hybrid next Wed 11:30 PT. Shelies in that morning and asked about a quiet prep room + pumping-friendly space. cc @Maya @Alex
Maya: Thanks. I can reserve a private prep room by 6F and mark a lactation room nearby. Will add host-only notes for front desk.
Alex: I'll do the panel from Zoom starting 11:30. Can the candidate be in a room with a stable ethernet jack? Prefer wired for coding exercise.
Facilities: We have a desk in Room 6-1 with wired port. I'll add a cable and power strip. Also log note: provide a small table for bag and a sign: "Interview in progress."
Priya: Travel stipend — she's requesting transit + parking. Company covers up to $100 local. Maya, can we prepay parking pass and leave a taxi slip?
Maya: Yes. I'll create a parking pass number and leave instructions at reception. Optionally hand a digital stipend via PayPal. Candidate prefers physical receipt for expense.
Priya: Candidate asked whether she can test Zoom mic beforehand. I'll let her know there's a quick check at 11:00 with IT.
Maya: I'll schedule an 11:00 connectivity check and invite IT. Also adding note: low-fragrance cleaning only.
Alex: I'll send the take-home prompt and a link to the shared coding doc. If wired fails fallback to hotspot and screen share.
Priya: I'll DM Mel travel ETA and remind about the 11:00 check. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
Maya: Done — invite updated, parking pass created, lactation room details in host-only notes.
Facilities: Sign printed and left at reception.
